TZA.note: The document states no authentication, e-signature or digital ID service.
It notes children have birth records but enter the ID system late; no exchange between the registers is stated.

facts.fact: The Home Affairs Minister said 27,520,835 people had been registered and 23,515,667 had received identification numbers; the registered count is about 39 percent of the 70.5 million population held (2025), calculated here.
The NIDA Director said a child-identification plan, registering children with NIDA from birth, is under pilot in three districts.

TZA.note: The document does not say who builds or maintains the system beyond NIDA as the authority.
It names no public register keyed on the ID number, only a strategy to connect institutions.

facts.fact: The Home Affairs Minister said 23,515,667 people had received identification numbers and 21,526,635 identity cards had been produced.
